summary.tldr: Removes a schedule from the Chemical Weapons Convention Implementation Act and updates references to it to match the treaty text.
what_it_does: Deletes the schedule from the Chemical Weapons Convention Implementation Act.
Removes references to that schedule in the Act, so the law stays aligned with the Chemical Weapons Convention as it may be amended over time.
who_it_affects: People and organisations subject to the Act
summary.background: The bill is meant to avoid possible differences between the treaty text and the version reproduced in the Act’s schedule.
